caption_L2L3: India is the most mature mHealth market place, with impact well beyond 8. Five countries have scores above 6: Brazil, China, India, South Africa, and the US. Denmark has the least mature mHealth market, at just above 2. Only 2 countries - Denmark and Germany - have scores below 4.
